faqs.a:
Section 303.3.2. Containers,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
303.3.2. Containers.
The operator of every establishment producing garbage shall provide, and at all times
                  cause to be utilized, leakproof containers provided with close-fitting covers for
                  the storage of such materials until removed from the premises for disposal."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
